Emirate-city market tables (Dubai emirate; Abu Dhabi city; Al Ain city). Local copy rents_raw/asteco_2024q3_uae.pdf. unit: SAR per year (average contracted rent, residential apartment)
source_name: REGA (Real Estate General Authority) Ejar rental indicators, quarterly district-level open data (Saudi National Open Data Platform)
notes: Mean annual rent of residential apartment (shaqqa, sakani) lease contracts registered on Ejar in 2026-Q1, city الرياض. REGA publishes average rent and deal count per district; I computed the city figure as the deal-weighted mean of district averages (= mean over contracts), 169498 contracts in 190 districts. Contracted rents, all apartment sizes. File is REGA open data mirrored on GitHub (open.data.gov.sa and rentalrei.rega.gov.sa timed out from here); local copy rents_raw/sau_rega_district_Riyadh-region-1st-Q-2026.csv. Cross-check: REGA city-level file states 28324 SAR for 2024-Q4 (176769 contracts), local copy rents_raw/sau_rega_Rental-indicators-for-*.csv.
